description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core middleware class 'ErrorHandlingMiddleware' responsible for catching exceptions during HTTP request processing, logging errors, and returning JSON-formatted error responses. It specifically handles custom 'RestException' instances and default internal server errors.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for global error handling in ASP.NET Core pipeline, capturing exceptions, logging, and serializing error responses.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method called on each HTTP request, delegates to next middleware and handles exceptions.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting appropriate HTTP status codes and response bodies based on exception type.
